items: `querySelectorAll` returns the current matching elements. Its list is a snapshot rather than a live record of later matches.
`textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.

blocks.text: The list shows Pack: Seeds and Pack: Water.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The returned list is a snapshot. New elements added later are not automatically added to that same list.
